sourceNotes: 新增默认关闭的实验性监控大屏，支持在局域网浏览器查看实时指标，并提供只读 MCP 入口
大屏支持多语言、明暗切换，以及农历、节气、节假日与调休提示
修复部分应用分身更新后因扩展属性丢失导致签名校验失败的问题

en: Adds an experimental monitoring dashboard, off by default, for live metrics in a local-network browser and a read-only MCP endpoint. Tailscale access to both endpoints is optional.
The dashboard supports multiple languages, light and dark appearance, and lunar dates, solar terms, holidays, and adjusted working days.
Fixes signature validation failures after updating some app clones caused by losing extended attributes.
